root_cause: computeNextDueDate() added the recurrence interval to the completion date instead of the previous due date, so every completed recurring task drifted by the days it was late.

feature_flag.name: tasks-recurring-due-dates
feature_flag.how_to_turn_off: Set tasks-recurring-due-dates to off for every workspace in the feature-flag store.

design_decisions.title: Create the tasks-recurring-due-dates key in the feature-flag store (default off)
design_decisions.decision: computeNextDueDate() reads the flag; off keeps the old completion-date rule on every path.
design_decisions.reviewer_must_confirm: Create the tasks-recurring-due-dates key in the feature-flag store (default off) before merging.
